data.title: bn-k8qd: Freeze snapshot choice and conditional control constraints
data.description: risk:high — adversarial architecture and failure-mode review required. Refute merge-readiness. Check: 1) snapshot pack/manifest authority and durability ordering; 2) same-position fold/schema upgrades and concurrent old/new saves; 3) retained-manifest GC and corrupt/unknown fallback; 4) conditional projection/dedupe v3/v4 atomicity, retry, retention, opaque cursor and downgrade constraints; 5) measurement gates and roadmap graph. Please answer: What failure modes exist? What edge cases need validation? How can we roll back if this breaks? What monitoring/alerts should we add? What input validation is needed?

data.reason: Adversarial review found nine required amendments: inclusive dedupe-retention boundary, Empty<Through(0) coverage ordering, serialized writer/root/GC protocol, build-pack sealing state, bounded non-O(N) discovery roots and explicit durability modes, stable public compatibility identity, corrupt same-head repair, honest-writer vs certified threat boundary, and reproducible high-cardinality A/B methodology.

data.body: Amendment evidence: (1) dedupe now defines inclusive positions, W > 0, w < W saturation, live p == window_start, exclusive/inclusive segment deletion inequalities, and boundary laws; (2) SnapshotCoverage orders Empty < Through(0) with sequential/concurrent laws; (3) one OS-locked writer serializes clones/root publication/GC, read-only offline opens never mutate, and UUID-scoped non-reused pack/root IDs prevent ABA; (4) active packs are footerless independently commit-framed records with explicit seal/roll recovery and read-vs-append/stale-FD tests; (5) flat O(N) manifests are replaced by bounded immutable COW roots with 1/1K/100K/1M scaling and explicit Buffered/Durable/grouped modes; (6) stable public SnapshotCompatibility forbids type_name/TypeId/unstable hashes, with trait break assigned to bn-ozi5 and adoption to bn-3l8n; (7) equal coverage validates current first and permits corrupt-current repair; (8) UnverifiedCache and CertifiedSnapshotRef now state exact hash presence and honest/malicious-writer boundary; (9) A/B requires at least ten counterbalanced pairs, run-level bootstrap, explicit warmup/cache/load rejection, at least 10,000 operations for p99, normalized durability, and same-host 32-cell control. Lead follow-up also makes destructive GC durability unconditional: fsync root prune before dependent deletion, then fsync deletion directories. Risk/design notes and both downstream bone acceptance contracts match. Validation: git diff --check clean; just fmt-check passed; first full just test reached 949/950 passes before the documented 3000-iteration snapshot law was interrupted at 476.9s; the established MESS_SNAPSHOT_LAW_ITERS=25 snapshot-law suite passed 4/4; the sole transient fold-chain performance-envelope failure under the immediate rerun passed isolated.

Final blocker response: Durable is now normative complete-root survival. Each root distinguishes Buffered from acknowledged Durable and binds its proof generation/closure hash. Reuse without I/O requires exact coverage by a prior acknowledged Durable root or synced checksummed proof ledger; otherwise the writer promotes every reachable pack frontier/page and creation/rename directory entry before root sync/rename/ack. The contract explicitly covers Buffered A reused by different-key Durable B, skipped existing content-addressed page writes, new active .open directory creation, and every promotion/data/directory/ledger/root sync failure. GC readability is no longer sufficient: GC first publishes a complete-closure Durable root, then prunes+fsyncs, deletes+fsyncs; failures prevent acknowledgement/pruning/dependent deletion as appropriate. Metrics include promotion bytes/files/pages/frontiers and all barrier classes. Administrative enumeration is now a narrow pinned-root scan_snapshots(cursor, limit) seam: shared deletion lease, root-bound capped cursor, O(log N + limit) work/O(height + limit) memory, partial diagnostics for doctor/inspect, and corruption/root mismatch/lost pin fail closed for retention. The 1M-head full scan has wall/RSS gates. Design, R5/R9/R10, bn-ozi5, and bn-3l8n mirror both contracts. Validation: git diff --check PASS; just fmt-check PASS; MESS_SNAPSHOT_LAW_ITERS=25 just test PASS, 950/950 tests in 133.319s (26 skipped).

data.reason: Independent final re-review approved 9521f239: all original findings, durable closure promotion, GC ordering, and bounded administrative scan integration are closed.
